items.title: Bond of Union (opening)
items.span: everything of this piece printed on this page (it continues on the next page)
items.verified: 2026-09-11 letter-for-letter pass against the scan at 2x–4x zoom (issue #3161); unpitched source — score with interval_ner, not pitch_ner. Letter-for-letter pass 2026-09-11 at 2x/4x zoom (issue #3161). Medium c (middle row holds c only); f e d on the row above, g a g / e f / a g on the row below read as the nearest pitches below c, so the tune spans E, to F. Durations: |c half, plain quarters, underlined slur-pairs eighths. Bars sum 4|8|8|8|4 (mode 4); the piece continues on the next page. 13 syllables on 15 notes; melismas marked.

items.title: Holy Candle (opening)
items.span: everything of this piece printed on this page (it continues on the next page)
items.verified: 2026-09-11 letter-for-letter pass against the scan at 2x–4x zoom (issue #3161); unpitched source — score with interval_ner, not pitch_ner. Letter-for-letter pass 2026-09-11 at 2x zoom (issue #3161). Medium e (middle row holds e only); c d / b a on the row below, f g a on the row above. Uncertain: the slur "e f" — the e is underlined and the f sits on the row above under the same arc; both read as eighths (the underline runs under the f column). "e d" under the arc = quarter + eighth. Bars are irregular as printed (6|8|9|7 eighths); nothing was regularised.

items.verified: 2026-09-11 letter-for-letter pass against the scan at 2x–4x zoom (issue #3161); unpitched source — score with interval_ner, not pitch_ner. Letter-for-letter pass 2026-09-11 at 2x zoom (issue #3161). Medium g; c d e on the row below, |c· a on the row above. Uncertain: the long dash printed at the bottom row under the "a … g" columns is read as a group underline (a, g eighths), which makes that bar sum to 8 like the pickup bar; if it is a hold mark instead, a and g are quarters. "|e d c" bar sums to 6 as printed.

items.title: Be Ye Holy (opening)
items.span: everything of this piece printed on this page (it continues on the next page)
items.verified: 2026-09-11 letter-for-letter pass against the scan at 2x–4x zoom (issue #3161); unpitched source — score with interval_ner, not pitch_ner. Letter-for-letter pass 2026-09-11 at 2x zoom (issue #3161). Medium c (lower row holds c only); d e g on the row above. Uncertain: the first note is printed "c·_" — read as a dotted quarter, the trailing low dash unresolved (the preface does not explain it). If that dash is the displaced underline of the d above it, d is an eighth and bar 1 sums to 8 like every other bar; as transcribed it sums to 9. Bar 4 also prints trailing dashes after d and c (ignored).

items.title: Gospel Liberty (first page)
items.span: everything of this piece printed on this page (it continues on the next page)
items.verified: 2026-09-11 letter-for-letter pass against the scan at 2x–4x zoom (issue #3161); unpitched source — score with interval_ner, not pitch_ner. Letter-for-letter pass 2026-09-11 at 2x/3x zoom (issue #3161). Medium g; c d e on the row below, a c d on the row above. Mode 3 with the ¢ sign: every bar sums to 6 eighths once the underline under "g a g" (three segments across the middle and top rows) is read as covering all three letters; the anacrusis (c d) and the closing c· are 3 eighths each. The repeat mark :| before "These" is written || so abcjs does not unroll it (the eval scores played notes). The second (cd), after the repeat, is underlined under both letters as printed. Lyric alignment is best-effort: the words run on across line breaks.

items.title: Paradise (first page)
items.span: everything of this piece printed on this page (it continues on the next page)
items.verified: 2026-09-11 letter-for-letter pass against the scan at 2x–4x zoom (issue #3161); unpitched source — score with interval_ner, not pitch_ner. Letter-for-letter pass 2026-09-11 at 2x/4x zoom (issue #3161). Medium g; c d e f on the row below, a b c on the row above. Checked at 4x: first-line "d ef" has the d plain (quarter), second-line "c· d ef" has the d underlined (eighth); both "e·f" groups are dotted quarter + eighth. Uncertain: "ded" carries a double underline (three sixteenths), which leaves that bar at 7.5 eighths where every other bar sums to 8 — a triplet reading would fill it; transcribed as printed. Continues on the next page.
